title: C++26: Standard Library Hardening Experiments
summary: This article explores experimental hardening features being introduced in the C++26 standard library, focusing on improving runtime safety and catching undefined behavior earlier in the development cycle.
problem_solved: Addresses C++ safety issues by adding built-in hardening mechanisms to the standard library that help detect programming errors and undefined behavior at runtime.
why_valuable: Provides safer default behaviors in C++, reducing security vulnerabilities and undefined behavior that have historically plagued C++ codebases.
